prose: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority has opened an investigation into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers in order to use their content to develop its AI and other services, Reuters reports via Techmeme. The Reuters article is paywalled to the fetcher (HTTP 401), so only the probe's existence and framing are verifiable from the feed.
highlights: UK CMA opens a probe into Meta's terms for publishers and advertisers
Question: whether exploitative terms secured content for AI development and other services
basis: Techmeme summary of the Reuters report; Reuters returns HTTP 401 to the fetcher
